# Purpose

A concise, faculty‑facing plan—derived from the Provost’s **Back to the Bay 2025** keynote—covering key ideas and concrete actions we can embed in Statistics and Data Science courses to **upskill** students.

> Reference keynote: *Back to the Bay Keynote Script – AI + Workforce Development*, August 13–14, 2025. Office of Academic Affairs, CSU East Bay. (link in **References**).

# Executive Summary of the Provost’s Vision

## What the Provost Means by “Upskilling”

- **Deliberately adding new capabilities and mindsets** that prepare students to **apply knowledge in unfamiliar situations**—not just listing more skills on a résumé. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
- Goal: Graduates who **learn quickly**, **communicate effectively**, **exercise judgment**, and **work across disciplines** in a world where **the only constant is change**. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
- Motivation: AI is **redefining “entry‑level”** work; employers expect more **complex, judgment‑based** tasks earlier in careers. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)

## Three-Part Framework

1. **AI Fluency** — Understand how AI works, what it can and **cannot** do, and how to apply it **responsibly**. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
2. **Human‑Centric Skills** — Empathy, ethics, communication, teamwork, leadership, and professionalism that **AI cannot replace**. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
3. **Agility** — The capacity to **adapt quickly** when conditions change and to course‑correct with confidence. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)

# Main Areas the Keynote Highlighted for Higher Education

- **Demographic & trust headwinds** for higher education; we must **prove value** and improve student **readiness** earlier in the curriculum. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
- **AI adoption in industry** is accelerating; “entry‑level” expectations are moving toward **judgment, communication, and collaboration**. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
- We must intentionally cultivate: **AI fluency**, **human‑centric skills**, and **agility** across **courses**, **co‑curriculars**, **community projects**, and **research**. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)

# Main Areas for the Future Job Market (CSUEB Students)

- Employers seek more than technical competence: **critical thinking**, **clear communication to diverse audiences**, **ethical judgment**, **collaboration with people and digital tools**, **professionalism**, **curiosity**, and **relational intelligence**. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)
- **Experience gap** matters as much as skills: students need **realistic, messy contexts** (people, deadlines, shifting priorities) to practice judgment. [Provost Keynote](https://www.csueastbay.edu/oaa/files/docs/provost-muscat-b2b-keynote.pdf)

# Citations from Chat

- Provost frames **“upskilling”** as deliberately adding new capabilities and mindsets so students can apply knowledge in unfamiliar situations, emphasizing adaptability, judgment, and communication.  
- His three-part framework: **AI Fluency**, **Human-Centric Skills**, and **Agility**, with examples across disciplines and emphasis on responsible AI use.  
- Job market context: AI is redefining **entry-level** roles; employers want critical thinking, communication, collaboration with people and digital tools, ethical judgment, professionalism, curiosity, and relational intelligence. Students must close the **experience gap**, not just the skills gap.
